title: 'The Vampire Lestat' Is a Wild Rock Opera That Doesn't Care If You're Confused
summary: Have you ever watched a show that made you go, 'Wait, what's happening?' That's 'The Vampire Lestat'! It's the third season of 'Interview with the Vampire' on AMC. The show follows Lestat, a 250-year-old vampire who starts a rock band. He sings songs like 'Butterscotch Bitch' and goes on tour to places like Detroit and Toledo. Why? Because a journalist named Daniel Malloy wrote a book revealing that vampires are real, but nobody believed him. So Lestat decides to prove it by performing on stage! The show is super fast-paced and doesn't explain anything. If you haven't seen the earlier seasons, you'll be lost. But that's part of the fun. Lestat is played by Sam Reid, who is totally electric. The show also introduces Lestat's mom, Gabriella, who is also a vampire and kind of crazy. The premiere is Sunday, June 7 at 9 p.m. ET. So if you like wild, weird, and musical vampires, this is for you!
why_it_matters: Sometimes the most fun things are a little weird or confusing, like trying a new game without reading the rules first.
